授業概要
この授業では，教授・学習過程心理学に関する最新の研究トピックの概観を行い，適切な研究計画や研究方法をデザインする力を高める。とりわけ，教育心理学における自己調整学習や動機づけ理論の観点から，学習のプロセスやメカニズムについて理解を深め，学習者ニーズの多様性を踏まえて，よりよい教育実践や学習支援のあり方について明らかにする。
This course covers the newest research topics related to psychology of teaching and learning process, and students will improve their ability to design appropriate research plans and methods.
Especially, from the perspective of self-regulated learning and motivation theory in educational psychology, graduate students will deepen their understandings of the learning process and mechanism, and clarify the way best practices and how to support learning, based on the diversity of learners' needs.
